plugins.name: sweeps
plugins.description: Two paired repository sweeps with opposite calibrations: truing finds what a repo says that is not so, parsimony proposes what should stop existing.

plugins.name: noun
plugins.description: The Noun Project icon API, as one skill: sign a request with the keys in the environment, search and fetch icons, download them in a colour, and mind the quota and the attribution.

plugins.name: exa
plugins.description: The Exa web search API, as one skill and a dependency-free CLI: search with excerpts, read known URLs, get a cited answer, with the key from the environment and cheap defaults.

plugins.name: rung
plugins.description: A structured discussion that leaves one person understanding something: an interviewer probes first, a dense expert statement stands as the pillar, and every later part is written on demand one rung down, in an anchored voice edited by seats that argue by letter and checked against the world.

plugins.name: rex
plugins.description: Put coding-agent conversations back in their Rex windows after the Rex server restarted: find the tabs that came back as empty shells, work out which conversation each held, prove it is not open anywhere else, and resume it.

plugins.name: declausing
plugins.description: Rewrite prose that reads as machine-written into prose that reads as written by someone who meant it, by applying Orwell's rules from "Politics and the English Language" (all but rule 5, so domain terms survive). Rewrites the text and reports what it cut.
